api: evidence_viewer.inspect_file(root, db, file_id, offset=0, length=4096, encoding="utf-8", format_name=None)
source_identity: Case-local files table ID; retained path/size/SHA256 verified before and after reading; all symlink ancestors refused. No arbitrary caller path.
byte_contract: offset/end_offset_exclusive are zero-based source-byte indexes; hex is authoritative, window_sha256 covers exactly returned bytes. Beyond EOF returns empty bytes with requested offset. Windows can be concatenated verbatim as bytes.
text_contract: Explicit UTF-8, UTF-16LE/BE or Latin-1, without automatic encoding guess or BOM removal. Text is a derived display. Invalid sequences use visible backslash escapes and absolute byte start/end metadata (first128 errors, exact total count). Window boundaries may split codepoints; hex remains authoritative.
json_contract: Ordered object pairs preserve duplicate keys; integers/reals preserved as exact numeric lexemes; nonstandard NaN/Infinity refused. JSON Unicode string values are decoded interpretation, never an exact byte-offset map.
xml_contract: Current Expat >=2.7.2 required. All XML-view DTD/entity/external-resolution/processing-instruction requests refused. No schema/XInclude transformations or network/file entity access. Ordered attributes, text and child elements/comments represented; lexical escaping/CDATA boundaries and outside-root comments are not preserved in tree; raw bytes are retained.
plist_contract: Binary and XML plist typed dictionary/array/data/UID/date/scalar tree. Duplicate dictionary keys cause structured refusal. XML preflight permits only canonical inert Apple plist1.0 DOCTYPE with no internal subset; never fetches referenced DTD. Other DTDs/entities/PI refused. Dates are plist values, not inferred event times.

limits.worker: isolated Python -I child, recursion limit500; no general filesystem/network or hard memory sandbox claimed

errors: Structured failures/resource limits retain exact raw window and explicit state/error. Unsupported binary formats require a separately validated adapter; no guessed decoding.
dependencies: No new dependency. Candidate Expat2.7.4 observed; check enforced at parse time.
pending: UI owns presentation and confirmation of displayed byte offsets
Additional binary formats require scoped adapters
No source authenticity, artifact semantic interpretation, deletion or identity assertion
mulder_tool: inspect_ancalor_evidence(case_path,file_id,offset,length,encoding,format_name): strict active Mulder direct-child retained review case
